# Bag of Holding (M20)
# Whenever you discard a card, exile that card from your graveyard.
# {2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.                       (compiled[0])
# {4}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return all cards exiled with this artifact to their owner's hand.

# In this engine every discard (effect, cost, cleanup) is the hand->graveyard MOVE_ZONE, so
# "you discard a card" is a zone change from your hand to your graveyard, one firing per card.
discard_trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            referent='event',
        ),
    }),
)

return_all = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=4)),
            CostSacrifice(
                target=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            ),
            CostTap(),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QUnbounded(),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
    }),
)

# 'all cards exiled with this artifact', whoever owns them: every exile zone, narrowed by the
# IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE link.
abilities = [discard_trigger, compiled[0], return_all, compiled[1]]
